name: ISO/IEC 27001
description: ISO/IEC 27001 is an international standard for information security management systems (ISMS). The 2022 revision restructured Annex A controls into four themes: Organizational, People, Physical, and Technological.

domains.name: Organizational Controls
domains.description: Controls related to organizational policies, roles, and responsibilities

domains.name: People Controls
domains.description: Controls related to personnel security and awareness

domains.name: Physical Controls
domains.description: Controls related to physical and environmental security

domains.name: Technological Controls
domains.description: Controls related to technical security measures

metadata.notes: Annex A controls restructured from 14 domains (2013) to 4 themes (2022)
